mapper.insert: insert into t_mq_send_failure (message_key, topic, ordering_key, body, retry_count, next_retry_time, status, last_error, create_time, update_time) values (#{messageKey}, #{topic}, #{orderingKey}, #{body}, 0, #{nextRetryTime}, 0, '', now(), now()) on duplicate key update topic = values(topic), ordering_key = values(ordering_key), body = values(body), next_retry_time = least(next_retry_time, values(next_retry_time)), status = 0, locked_at = null, update_time = now()
mapper.select: select id, message_key, topic, ordering_key, body, retry_count, next_retry_time, status, locked_at, last_error, create_time, update_time from t_mq_send_failure where ((status = 0 and next_retry_time <= #{now}) or (status = 1 and locked_at <= #{lockExpiredAt})) and (ordering_key is null or not exists ( select 1 from t_mq_send_failure earlier where earlier.ordering_key = t_mq_send_failure.ordering_key and earlier.id < t_mq_send_failure.id )) order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update t_mq_send_failure set retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, status = 0, locked_at = null, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
